rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Solana
positions.catalyst: SOL carries the only differentiated positive catalyst in the majors: spot Solana ETFs have posted NET INFLOWS on every single trading day in July 2026 (BSOL cumulative ~$1.14B) while spot Bitcoin ETFs bled ~$8.2B across an 8-week outflow streak and Ethereum funds have joined them in the red. The Alpenglow consensus upgrade (targeting sub-150ms finality, expected activation Q3) plus recent Grayscale staking-ETF fee cuts and the Morgan Stanley MSOL staking ETP form a durable, multi-week demand stack. On a soft tape SOL held roughly flat (~$73.61, canonical asOf 2026-07-31T13:09Z) while ETH (~$1,882, -2% d/d) and BTC (~$63,661, -1.6% d/d) slipped — modest but real relative strength driven by its independent flow bid.
positions.driver: Closed prior ETH at 1882.00 (canonical dashboard feed) for -$219.09 (entry 1921.41). Rotated into SOL as the best risk-adjusted next-24h pick on a low-edge day: it is the only major with an active positive catalyst (persistent daily ETF inflows + Alpenglow runway) and it showed mild relative strength by holding flat while BTC/ETH gave back ~2%. Wins vs runners-up: BTC (~63,661) is mid ETF-outflow bleed with no fresh catalyst; ETH (~1,882) has lost its earlier inflow edge as ETH funds turned red alongside BTC, leaving it soft with no differentiated driver. NOTE: this is a flow/relative-strength thesis, NOT a momentum breakout — an initial bad third-party quote suggested SOL was up ~16.5% overnight; the canonical dashboard feed shows SOL roughly flat (-0.7% vs yesterday's 74.13), and the position/prices here are corrected to that feed. A 10% stop on a higher-beta alt keeps the payoff asymmetric.
positions.risks: The bull case rests on the ETF-inflow streak continuing; any single-day break in that streak removes SOL's core edge. Broad risk-off led by BTC weakness could drag SOL lower despite its independent bid, and without fresh momentum the setup is catalyst-dependent rather than trend-confirmed. A decisive loss of the ~$70 shelf would signal the flow bid is failing. Hard stop 66.25 (-10%) caps downside while leaving room for normal high-beta chop.
